control.description-key: Displays a visual completeness score for related Task records linked to the current record, highlighting incomplete tasks.

property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Bind to any single-line text field on the form. The control uses it as an anchor.

property.name: taskEntityLogicalName
property.description-key: Logical name of the related task entity (default: task).

property.name: lookupFieldName
property.description-key: Logical name of the lookup field on the task entity pointing back to this record (default: itr_onboardingcase).

property.name: completedFieldName
property.description-key: Logical name of the Yes/No field on the task entity indicating completion (default: itr_completed).

property.name: dueDateFieldName
property.description-key: Logical name of the date field on the task entity used to determine overdue/due-today status (default: scheduledend).
